global_setting: Global Setting: Bright daytime in a bustling, magical grand dining hall. Long dining tables laden with food, amidst gothic architecture. Live-action fantasy film, warm lighting, and rich magical aesthetic.
global_action: Global Action/Motion: [character1] he flinches and recoils in sudden surprise as scattered debris and food rain down around him. [character2] he flinches and ducks slightly alongside [character1] when the sudden crash scatters food across the table. [character3] it flies continuously through the hall, swoops down rapidly, and crashes directly into a bowl of chips. A bowl of chips bursts, sending food and feathers flying upward into the air upon impact. All shots match on [action cut], resulting action/motion continuous and spatio-temporal coherent.
